title: Intro Legs
notes: Beginner day. Form first. Every set should end with about 3 reps left in the tank; nothing should hurt. If a weight feels heavy, drop it and log what was used.

exercises.name: Box Squat to Bench (BW)
exercises.note: sit back to the bench, tap, stand up; chest up, knees track over toes

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.note: hold one DB at the chest, elbows inside knees, sit between the heels

exercises.name: DB RDL
exercises.note: 10 lb in each hand; soft knees, push hips back, flat back, DBs slide down the thighs

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (BW)
exercises.note: on a mat; squeeze glutes at the top for 1 second

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (BW, each leg)
exercises.note: step back, back knee gently toward the floor; hold a rail for balance if needed

exercises.name: Calf Raise (BW)
exercises.note: slow up, slow down, full range

exercises.name: Plank (sec)
exercises.note: straight line head to heels, squeeze glutes
